code.originalText: Six-month diabetes review with glaucoma imaging

text.paragraph: Six-month diabetes review with glaucoma imaging. [S]

Mr. Cash returns for his six-month review. Since midodrine was raised to 5 mg he rarely feels lightheaded, only if he stands quickly after lunch, and he has had no falls. He finished physical therapy and does the home exercises most days. The low-vision therapist reviewed his home lighting, and a second stair handrail is in place. His fasting home readings run 110 to 140 mg/dL, with none below 70. He has no scalp tingling or trouble passing urine and takes the last midodrine by mid-afternoon. He uses both eye drops daily and notices no change in his vision. The FIT kit from the wellness visit has not been returned. [S]

list.item:
Type 2 diabetes with diabetic autonomic neuropathy (E11.43). HbA1c 7.3%, below his goal of 7.5%, with no hypoglycemia. Kidney screening normal: eGFR 73 and urine albumin-creatinine ratio 16 mg/g. [S]
Continue metformin 1000 mg twice daily and sitagliptin 100 mg daily.
HbA1c every six months now that he is at goal.

Neurogenic orthostatic hypotension (I95.1). Standing systolic pressure 120 mmHg on midodrine 5 mg, above the goal of 100, and no falls. Lying pressure 148/82 mmHg, with no supine hypertension. [S]
Continue midodrine 5 mg three times daily and the non-drug measures.

Primary open-angle glaucoma, severe stage (H40.1133). Eye pressures 14 and 15 mmHg. Nerve fiber layer thickness is unchanged (60 and 57 µm, against 61 and 57 at intake), acuity is stable, and the 24-2 fields show no new defect against intake, so the pressure check missed in the spring caused no measurable loss. [S]
Continue latanoprost and dorzolamide.
Eye clinic review in three to six months; OCT and fields every six months; add a 10-2 field test at the next field visit.

Mild nonproliferative diabetic retinopathy (E11.3293). No change reported by the eye clinic. [S]
Dilated retinal examination yearly.

Hyperlipidemia (E78.5). LDL 74 mg/dL three months ago, just above the goal below 70. [S]
Lipid panel with lipoprotein(a) at the annual review.

Preventive care. The hepatitis C antibody drawn at the last visit has no result on file, and the FIT kit has not been returned. [S]
